name: indep_op
description: Independence predicate of a matroid: M.Indep S means S is independent in M.
lean_statement: def indep_op {α : Type*} (M : Matroid α) (S : Set α) : Prop := M.Indep S

name: is_base_op
description: Base predicate: M.IsBase B means B is a maximal independent subset of M.E.
lean_statement: def is_base_op {α : Type*} (M : Matroid α) (B : Set α) : Prop := M.IsBase B

name: is_circuit_op
description: Circuit predicate: M.IsCircuit C means C is a minimal dependent set in M.
lean_statement: def is_circuit_op {α : Type*} (M : Matroid α) (C : Set α) : Prop := M.IsCircuit C

name: closure_op
description: Closure operator: M.closure S is the smallest flat containing S ∩ M.E.
lean_statement: def closure_op {α : Type*} (M : Matroid α) (S : Set α) : Set α := M.closure S

name: dual_op
description: Dual matroid: M✶ has bases that are complements (in M.E) of bases of M. Notation: M✶.
lean_statement: def dual_op {α : Type*} (M : Matroid α) : Matroid α := M✶

name: is_loop_def
description: An element e of M.E is a loop if {e} is dependent.
lean_statement: def is_loop_def {α : Type*} (M : Matroid α) (e : α) : Prop := e ∈ M.E ∧ ¬ M.Indep {e}

name: is_flat_def
description: A set F ⊆ M.E is a flat (closed set) iff it equals its own closure.
lean_statement: def is_flat_def {α : Type*} (M : Matroid α) (F : Set α) : Prop := F ⊆ M.E ∧ M.closure F = F

name: is_dep_def
description: A subset D of M.E is dependent if it is not independent.
lean_statement: def is_dep_def {α : Type*} (M : Matroid α) (D : Set α) : Prop := D ⊆ M.E ∧ ¬ M.Indep D

name: indep_empty_thm
description: The empty set is independent in any matroid.
lean_statement: theorem indep_empty_thm {α : Type*} (M : Matroid α) : M.Indep ∅ := M.empty_indep

name: closure_idempotent_thm
description: Closure is idempotent: M.closure (M.closure S) = M.closure S.
lean_statement: theorem closure_idempotent_thm {α : Type*} (M : Matroid α) (S : Set α) : M.closure (M.closure S) = M.closure S := M.closure_closure S

name: isBase_subset_ground_thm
description: Every base is contained in the ground set.
lean_statement: theorem isBase_subset_ground_thm {α : Type*} (M : Matroid α) (B : Set α) (hB : M.IsBase B) : B ⊆ M.E := hB.subset_ground
